title: German Pastrami Sandwiches
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic pastrami sandwich, using thinly sliced german bread and a variety of toppings.
instructions: Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
Slice the german bread and toast until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of veggie mayo on the bottom slice of bread.
Add a layer of sliced pastrami on top of the mayo.
Add a layer of lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles on top of the pastrami.
Add a layer of cheese on top of the vegetables (if using).
Spread a layer of mustard on the top slice of bread.
Place the top slice of bread on the sandwich and press until crispy.
Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the bread is crispy and the cheese is melted (if using).
